title: 耶鲁研究员：马斯克一人可碾压任何参议员，财富波动如买汽水
speaker: William D. Cohan

segments.en: Share a brown versus Bernie Moreno in Ohio.
segments.zh: 俄亥俄州的谢罗德·布朗对阵伯尼·莫雷诺。

segments.en: And the two campaigns combined spent about $110, $115 million together, not any one campaign, but together.
segments.zh: 两个竞选团队总共花费了约1.1亿到1.15亿美元，不是单方，而是合计。

segments.en: The two, that's what the two campaign spent Elon Musk spent $250 million in that campaign race.
segments.zh: 这就是两个竞选团队的花费，而埃隆·马斯克在那场竞选中花费了2.5亿美元。

segments.en: So by himself, he could swamp any US Senator.
segments.zh: 所以他一个人就能碾压任何一位美国参议员。

segments.en: But the way I would put it is if you look at the day to day fluctuations in his wealth, right?
segments.zh: 但我想说的是，如果你看看他财富的日常波动，对吧？

segments.en: Just the random motions of the stock market.
So he could, what he could spend in a political camp, when he spent in that political campaign, be like 1% of the day-to-day fluctuations in his wealth.
segments.zh: 所以他在政治竞选中的花费，可能只相当于他财富日常波动的1%。

segments.en: So he can swamp any Senator, any Congressman, probably any presidential candidate, about as casually as you or I would buy a soda.
segments.zh: 所以他可以碾压任何参议员、任何众议员，甚至任何总统候选人，就像你我买一瓶汽水一样随意。

segments.en: Again, this segment is not making me feel better. I'm very glad to see you, but you're not shearing me up on a Saturday.
segments.zh: 再说一次，这段内容并没有让我感觉好一些。很高兴见到你，但你并没有在周六让我振奋起来。
